title: Open Robotics RViz RGBF32PCTransformer PointField Out-Of-Bounds Read Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-134049)
description: A vulnerability in Open Robotics RViz's RGBF32PCTransformer component allows network-adjacent attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) by triggering an out-of-bounds read. This flaw arises from improper validation of PointCloud2 message data, enabling attackers to read beyond allocated memory without authentication.
